id32_notes: ID32 does not inherit ID16's exhaustion exceptions. GCC strict ref inputs expect three access failures: count_spilled_pseudo reads hard_regno_nregs[-1][16] before checking r < 0 (reload1.c:1868), confirmed with GDB. Both ref32 invocations complete. Non-strict GCC disables global instrumentation for this source bug. Non-strict musl ID32 additionally expects the two gcc-pp.c ref commands to fail with access diagnostics, as observed in CI revision 28d1f76c3 and reproduced locally: vn_nary_may_trap unconditionally reads op[1] from a length-1 CONVERT_EXPR record, eight bytes beyond its 4072-byte obstack allocation (tree-ssa-sccvn.c:3365). GDB confirmed op[1] starts exactly at the allocation end; COMPOUND check 11, function ID 0xaf8520a70693ba8d. The gcc-smaller.c and both ref32 commands still pass. This exception does not apply to glibc ID32 or test inputs. Blender is excluded because serialized pointer identities are unsupported. Other deviations must fail for review.
